Final for Publication

17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans — 3000-3010 N. Oakley Ave., Chicago, IL

Proposed Zoning: RT-3.5 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District

Lot Area: 15,625 sq. ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is proposing to develop the subject property with five (5)
new two-story single family homes. Each single family home will sit on a
zoning lot that measures 25 ft. wide by 125 ft. deep and contain 3,125 sq.
ft. of total lot area. Each single family home will measure 30 ft.-10.5 inches
in height. Each single-family home will be supported by a detached two (2)
car garage at the rear. Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-0303-D optional
Administrative Adjustment and Variation and pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1101-
B of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, the Applicant is seeking to reduce the
required front setback for each home to 10 ft., and is seeking all relief
necessary, as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, for the attached plans.

(A) The Project’s Floor Area Ratio:
a. Home 1 (northernmost lot): 3,187 sq. ft. (1.02 FAR)

b. Home 2: 3,218 sq. fi. (1.03 FAR)
c. Home 3: 3,218 sq. ft. (1.03 FAR)
d. Home 4: 3,218 sq. ft. (1.03 FAR)

e. Home 5 (southernmost lot): 3,187 sq. ft. (1.02 FAR)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): 3,125 sq. ft. per single family
home. Please note there will be five (5) single family homes proposed on 15,625 sq.
ft. of land. Each home will sit on its own 3,125 sq. ft. zoning lot.
